summary.zh: 分散是行动小队的默认状态。成员不会集中行动，而是继续按照普通学生日程 AI 活动。
summary.en: Dispersed is the default action squad state. Members do not gather and instead continue following normal student schedule AI.

items.zh: 成员继续按年级和时间段自动前往不同地块。
items.en: Members continue moving between provinces based on grade and time block.

items.zh: 地图上的小队标记显示在总部位置。
items.en: The squad marker appears at headquarters on the map.

items.zh: 分散状态不会执行区域行动。
items.en: Dispersed squads cannot perform region actions.

items.zh: 存在感最低，不会主动提高管理层察觉。
items.en: It has the lowest visibility and does not actively raise faculty awareness.

items.zh: 只有分散状态下，迁移总部可以立即完成。
items.en: Only dispersed squads can relocate headquarters instantly.
